summary.name: Vidnoz AI
summary.one_liner: Vidnoz AI is a web-based AI video generator that creates videos from text using AI avatars, AI voices, voice cloning and video translation.
use_cases: translate videos into other languages with lip sync
make marketing and sales videos from templates
clone your own voice for voiceovers
create a digital twin avatar of yourself
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI video generator where users select an AI avatar, enter text for speech, and produce a video. It advertises 1900+ AI avatars with lip sync and body language, 2000+ AI voices, and voice cloning of your own voice. Users can create a custom digital twin avatar and generate up to 5 minutes of AI video per scene. It also offers free video translation with lip syncing across 140+ languages and 2800+ editable video templates. The page states a single login gives access to all Vidnoz AI services and mentions security and privacy policy commitments.
notable: 1900+ AI avatars with lip sync and body language
free AI video translation with lip syncing in 140+ languages
caveats: The page does not give detailed pricing or free-tier limits beyond calling creation 'free' in places
Testimonial and ROI figures (e.g., $10,000 savings, +52% engagement) are vendor marketing claims, not verified here
Page is mostly marketing copy with few technical specifics
